summary: Pembina Pipeline Corp filed a Form 6-K on May 7, 2026, reporting Q1 2026 financial results, a raise in quarterly dividend to $0.735/share (3.5% increase), and updated 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $4.35-$4.55 billion. The filing also notes operational updates including PGI projects entering service and Peace Pipeline recontracting. This is a routine earnings release with no special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review.
